intro: Paper 1 and Paper 2 are each marked out of 100 and the NEA (Language in Action) out of 100. AQA doubles each paper's mark, so the overall boundaries are out of 500 (40% for each paper and 20% for the NEA); the calculator does the doubling for you.
source: AQA's published subject grade boundaries for A-level English Language (7702), out of 500: June 2026, 2025, 2024, 2023 and 2022 boundary documents.
asSource: AS English Language (7701) is out of 140 (two 70-mark papers); see AQA's AS grade boundaries document for each year's figures.
